data.one_liner: Cyrillic Windows-1251 (cp1251) character encoding implementation for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for encoding and decoding text using the Windows-1251 character set, commonly used for Cyrillic languages. Supports chunked conversion for streaming data and configurable error handling for invalid characters.
use_when: You need to parse or generate text using the Windows-1251 character encoding.
You are working with legacy data or systems utilizing Cyrillic Windows-1251 script.
avoid_when: You are working purely with standard UTF-8 encoded text.
You need modern multi-language support where standard Unicode is already fully implemented.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no external dependencies.
Supports chunked conversion for streaming data.
Configurable invalid character and byte behavior.
weaknesses: Limited to a single legacy character encoding.
